items.title: Richard Brunies Interview, 1959-04-27
items.q: Merritt and them, they did the same thing. I'd buy an instrument, they'd come along behind me and pick it up and blend it up.

ctx.x: Well, can you tell us a little bit about your brother, Henry, because he's not here, of course, to talk for us. Well, he was a hot friend. He was a wonderful, I've heard. Yes, he was. He was a showman with his son. I had that to say. How much younger was he than you? He was younger than you? Oh, yeah. Next to him. About five years. About five years. And, uh...

He'd be about 65. What's his name? Merritt and them, they did the same thing. I'd buy an instrument, they'd come along behind me and pick it up and blend it up. That's how they all went out. I'd blow a blow and essence.

How much older was Rudy than you? About... Oh, Rudy was about three or four. About five years. About five years old. Oh, you're 69? He'd be... Yeah, about five. That's right. That's right. I'm right. How old was your father when he died? Do you remember? 62, I believe. And when was that? Oh, I spent quite some time. About 10, quite some time. About 10... About 10... About 10... About 10... About 10... About 10... About 10... About 10... About 10... About 10... About 10...
